title: Vue.js Review Quiz
description: Review the small examples from this Vue.js course. Take your time and read the reason given for each answer.

questions.question: What does {{ club }} show?
questions.explanation: A Vue template describes the page. Double curly brackets show a JavaScript value as text.

questions.question: What does ref add to this value?
options: It saves the value to every device
questions.explanation: A ref is a small container for a value that Vue can watch. Templates unwrap its value for you.

questions.question: What does the colon in :href mean?
options: Use the value of a JavaScript expression
questions.explanation: v-bind connects an HTML attribute to a JavaScript value. A colon is the short form of v-bind.

questions.question: Which message appears when ready is false?
questions.explanation: v-if includes a page part when its rule is true. v-else gives another part for the false case.

questions.question: Why use book.id as the key?
options: It stays with the same book when items move
questions.explanation: v-for makes one page part per list item. A stable key helps Vue follow the right item when the list changes.

questions.question: What updates name in this example?
questions.explanation: v-model connects a form field to a value. Typing updates the value, and changing the value updates the field.

questions.question: When does this computed result need to change?
questions.explanation: A computed value is based on other reactive values. Vue can update it when the values it reads change.

questions.question: Who supplies a child prop?
questions.explanation: Props are values a parent gives a child component. The child reads them to decide what to show.

questions.question: What carries the chosen title to the parent?
questions.explanation: A child can emit an event to ask its parent to do something. This keeps the child from owning the parent's state.

questions.question: When is No message yet used?
options: Whenever the parent has a script
When no slot content is supplied
questions.explanation: A slot leaves a place where a parent can supply page content. It makes a wrapper reusable.

questions.question: Why call clearInterval on unmount?
options: To stop work belonging to the removed component
questions.explanation: A mounted hook can start work after a component joins the page. An unmounted hook can stop that work when the component leaves.

questions.question: What does @submit.prevent stop?
questions.explanation: A form and a reactive array can work together. Each submitted title becomes a new item with its own stable id.
